stops.name: Naturpark Westensee
stops.detail: At the Westensee Nature Park, we are involved in environmental education, nature conservation, sustainable tourism and regional development. But also beyond the boundaries of the nature park we are active with the local action in nature conservation. Here we work with agricultural nature conservation consultancy and the care and development of important habitats for the preservation of our nature and landscape.
